method: Pick-only flexibility sampler. Bans retain native policy; no lookahead simulations. Candidates in native pool and within one native point of strongest; if baseline is outside that band retain it. Count up to three strong alternatives per remaining role after removing its strongest followup, with strong defined within six native points. Tilt native-temperature sampling weights by at most 2x using flexibility. Constants fixed before evaluation. Final own pick unchanged. Paired complete drafts and 16 separately seeded holdout strategy/role/default-item-order profiles; own draft-fit strategy and default items, not production configuration optimization. Related deterministic cases, not PvP probabilities.
